verdict.rationale: The open MBLS portal offers a public search by business name or file number, so a founder can look up their entity record. The only filing-specific tracking documented is a Transaction History of completed filings, kept for 90 days and available only behind an Online Account login rather than on public pages. The main sos.state.mn.us site is also bot-walled by a CAPTCHA. The Department of Revenue refund tracker is a different agency's service and is not credited. missing for 10: documented public status lookup for pending filings or applications, explicit description of the status fields the search returns, visibility of in-process (not just completed) filings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
